parsed.rationale: The structural evidence explicitly reports `shared_field_count: 0` and `jaccard: null`, meaning these two protocols share no overlapping members. `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` (line 20, HLSPlayer) exposes AVFoundation-centric members such as `currentTime:() -> CMTime`, `seekableTimeRanges:[NSValue]`, and `seek:(to time: CMTime) async -> Bool`, while `AudioEnginePlayerProtocol` (line 34, MP3Streamer) exposes audio-engine-specific members such as `eventStream:AsyncStream<AudioPlayerEvent>`, `installRenderTap:()`, `scheduleBuffer:(_ buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer)`, and `stop:()`. The only superficial overlap is the presence of `pause:()` and `play:()` in both, but their signatures differ (`play:()` vs `play:() throws`) and the surrounding domain semantics — HLS/AVPlayer timeline seeking versus PCM buffer scheduling and render taps — are fundamentally distinct. Introducing a shared parent protocol would create a false abstraction coupling two unrelated playback subsystems.
